title: Flirtation Reel (alternating)
author: Tony Parkes
problems: Row 4 "neighbors gyre once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 stand too close to gyre.
choices: A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.

figures.text: down the hall and turn alone (ones in the middle)
up the hall and end facing neighbor
neighbors start a full hey - rights on ends, lefts in center
neighbors swing, end facing across the set
twos swing, end facing UP & step between the next ones
up the hall and turn alone (twos in the middle)
down the hall and end facing neighbor
neighbors start a full hey - rights on ends, lefts in center
ones swing, end facing DOWN & step between the next twos
